digest.component_or_area: LLM model class routing and sub-call configuration
propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-calls construct RunRequest with config=cfg and no model class, causing them to inherit cfg.model and bypass model-class configuration regardless of class vocabulary settings
overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic with 18 of 23 calls, all bypassing class config and routing to direct Anthropic instead of configured Bedrock provider
ticket-digest runs on store write path during routine rebar comment/create calls, exposing ticket content to unconfigured Anthropic without gate invocation or verdict visibility

With class table configured to differ from cfg.model, config-B measurement confirms all four bypass sites resolve to cfg.model instead of their class assignment; config-A with both Bedrock shows zero Anthropic calls, establishing inheritance as the root cause
Regression test must construct overlap-judge trigger deliberately by ensuring BM25F candidate retrieval returns neighbors, as gate execution alone does not guarantee judge invocation
